doc.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Basie rebuilds the big band, with Freddie Green
summary: Basie says he needs Freddie Green and a full band, and repeatedly forms and disbands bands until the sound satisfies him.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Are we rolling, Tim? Well we were talking about the small Basie group. Did it get to the point where Basie wanted the whole band back again?

Yes. Are you ready now? One night, see Freddie Green, he didn’t join the group right away, the small group. But one night he said, “I need Freddie, I’ve got to have him.” He said, “he’s like my left hand.” So he got Freddie, then he said, “I’m going to have to have a big band man, I’m so used to the sound, I’ve got to get the band back. So he got a lot of guys together, and we got the band together and had a rehearsal down to, I think we had this at Club DeLisa. In the daytime we used to go down there, there was nobody there. And the band sounded pretty good. Let’s see who’d we have in that band? Oh, well you know it changed three times. What he would do he’d get all these guys and we’d play and he’d listen. And you could tell if he wasn’t satisfied, he used to keep his head down you know. Then he’d give everybody notice, everybody in the band, and he’d give notice. He’d say he was going to break up the band. All right he’d break up the band, and then he’d come around our rooms at night. That’s just me and you. That’s just me and Clark Terry. That’s just me and Gus. That’s sure just me and Freddie Green. He said, “now don’t worry, I’m going to get another band together.” He got another one and that one was better.
